Description: A guest seller can start the seller application.
Seller can submit a business application.
The system validates required seller application fields.
Seller can upload business documents such as a W-9.
The system blocks an invalid document upload.
Admin can review a seller application.
Admin can approve a seller.
Admin can reject a seller.
Admin can request more information from a seller.
Seller can update and resubmit an application.
An approved seller can open the seller dashboard.
A pending or rejected seller cannot sell.
Admin can suspend a seller.
Admin can reactivate a seller.
Seller accepts the marketplace seller agreement.
Seller can create a public storefront.
Seller can edit logo, banner, or store details.
Buyer can open a seller storefront.
Buyer can view products on a seller store.
Admin can disable a storefront.
